$comment: Copy to <Project>/API-Testing/config.json. Values here are URLs and NAMES only — never secret values: tokens live in the environment variables the suite references as {env.NAME}, and api-run.mjs refuses to start while any of them is unset. baseUrl must be staging/dev — functional suites create, update and delete, so the runner refuses environment 'production' with no override.

secrets.$comment: Documentation for whoever runs the suite — which variables to export and what each one is. The runner's ground truth is the suite itself: it scans for {env.*} references, so a variable listed here but unused is harmless, and one used but unlisted is still enforced.
secrets.API_TOKEN: bearer token of the seeded staging test user
secrets.API_TOKEN_SECOND_USER: token of a DIFFERENT user — authorization checks need someone else's resource
